title: Pick schematic components and recalculate their size
summary: Shows interactive point picking and hit testing on a schematic sheet, reading an object's properties with ExportToParameters, and recalculating component bounds inside a proper change bracket.
phrasings: let the user click a component on a schematic
hit test objects under a point on a sheet
dump a schematic object's properties as a parameter string
recalculate the bounding rectangle of a component

commands.name: ChangeComponentSize
commands.description: Pick components and recalculate their size
commands.params: Mode=Pick|Selected (default Pick; Pick only from the menu)|At=<x,y> (optional, mils, one hit test without a prompt)|Max=<n> (optional, Pick limit)|Export=true|false (default true)

commands.name: ListComponents
commands.description: List the components on the current sheet (test helper)
